Credits and Fair Use

course hub · textbook · glossary · people and organizations

Use of images

This site is a nonprofit course resource of the University of Washington Bothell. Images are credited where they appear. Most are in the public domain or under open licenses, and each is credited with its author and license.

Some film frames, game screenshots, research-paper figures and historical photographs are used under the fair-use provision of United States copyright law (17 U.S.C. § 107) for teaching, commentary and criticism. Each is shown small, credited to its owner and discussed in the text, following the Code of Best Practices in Fair Use for OpenCourseWare and the Visual Resources Association's Statement on the Fair Use of Images for Teaching, Research, and Study.

Rights holders who object to a use can write to mgav@uw.edu with [CSS 551] in the subject line; the material is removed while the request is reviewed.
